scope.geometry: Untrimmed locus of a decoded finite straight ACIS edge
scope.public_api: drw_evaluateAcisStraightCoedge maps normalized traversal fraction through the retained coedge sense and delegates to drw_evaluateAcisStraightEdge.
scope.sense_policy: 0 follows raw edge start-to-end; 1 reverses that direction; all other values are rejected.
scope.tolerance_policy: Endpoint-to-supporting-line consistency tolerance is finite, nonnegative, and explicit; no modeler default is inferred.
scope.refusal_policy: Unknown sense, non-finite/out-of-range fraction, invalid tolerance, malformed edge, or unrepresentable point returns false without changing output.
non_claims: native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification
